description: DoubleVerify impression beacons on tps.doubleverify.com/visit.jpg and tpsc-video-*.doubleverify.com/visit.jpg. Google documents ctx, cmp, plc, and sid on the generated wrapper as dvparams. Those names ride on visit.jpg. OMID dvtp_src.js, RTB, VAST wrappers, and event.png quartiles are not contracted. Amazon-hosted /dv/ hops stay vendor/amazon-vfw.

params.name: ctx
params.description: It is the DoubleVerify context or advertiser key. Google documents it on the generated FlashTalking and DoubleVerify wrapper as ctx inside dvparams. The visit.jpg beacon carries the same name.
params.fix_hint: Copy the generated DoubleVerify tag so visit.jpg carries ctx from dvparams.

params.name: cmp
params.description: It is the DoubleVerify campaign key. Google documents it as cmp inside dvparams. Values may be numeric or a DV-prefixed id such as DV064005.
params.fix_hint: Keep cmp from the generated DoubleVerify tag on the visit.jpg query.

params.name: plc
params.description: It is the DoubleVerify placement key. Google documents it as plc inside dvparams.
params.fix_hint: Keep plc from the generated DoubleVerify tag on the visit.jpg query.

params.name: sid
params.description: It is the DoubleVerify site or supply key. Google documents it as sid inside dvparams. Generated tags sometimes send a name rather than digits.
params.fix_hint: Keep sid from the generated DoubleVerify tag on the visit.jpg query.
